# USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries — Critical Minerals & Rare Earths

> Structured extraction of the USGS *Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026* (MCS 2026) for ~50 commodities relevant to U.S. critical-mineral policy. Every value is traceable to the original USGS PDF; missing values surface as "N/A" and USGS-specific sentinels (W / E / >N / <N / NA) appear verbatim alongside numeric data. The dataset is rebuilt locally from cached PDFs and shipped as JSON + CSV; no derived or interpolated values.

## Data

- [Bundle JSON](data.json): canonical machine-readable form. One `ElementRecord` per commodity (and per rare-earth-element / per-PGM alias). Includes `salient_stats` (5-year US table), `import_sources_by_category`, `world_production` (per-country mine production + reserves), prose blocks, and footnotes. Latest-year sentinels (W = withheld, E = net exporter, >N = "more than N", NA = USGS-reported not-available) appear in both `raw_values` and `latest_year_sentinels`.
- [Flat CSV](data.csv): one row per (element, import-source-category). Wide schema (~2000 columns) covering identity + latest-year summary + per-year salient stats + per-country production / capacity / reserves. Each numeric column is mixed-type — it carries either a number or a USGS sentinel verbatim. Pandas users coerce sentinels to NaN via `pd.to_numeric(col, errors="coerce")`.

## Source & methodology

- [USGS MCS 2026 index](https://pubs.usgs.gov/periodicals/mcs2026/): authoritative source. Each `ElementRecord.source_url` points at the specific commodity PDF used as input.
- [Project README](https://github.com/pranava0x0/usgs-mineral-commodity-summaries#readme): pipeline architecture, extraction conventions, sentinel semantics.

## Conventions

- **`—` (em-dash) is zero** — USGS convention for "produced nothing"; renders as `0.0` in numeric fields.
- **`NA` is null** — USGS-reported "data not available"; renders as `None` in JSON, `N/A` in CSV.
- **`W` is withheld** — proprietary-data suppression. Numeric field is `None`; CSV cell carries `W`.
- **`E` is net exporter** — appears only in Net Import Reliance rows.
- **`>N` / `<N`** — bounded approximation. Numeric field carries `N`; CSV cell carries the inequality verbatim.
- **Year tagging** — column names like `australia_production_2025` are taken straight from the PDF's table sub-header band; no interpolation.

## Optional

- [Per-element audit reports](data/audit/): one directory per commodity with `audit.md` (extracted values + verbatim PDF text side by side) and `page-NN.png` screenshots of the source PDF.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/pranava0x0/usgs-mineral-commodity-summaries): source code, tests, refresh workflows.
